types.name: Nuclear plant
types.description: Every nuclear power plant in the database. Value is the plant capacity in MW. Source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).

types.name: Hydroelectric dam
types.description: Hydro plants of at least 250 MW. Source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).

types.name: Coal & lignite plant
types.description: Coal and lignite plants of at least 1,000 MW. Several have closed since 2021; the database is not updated. Source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).

types.name: Gas power plant
types.description: Gas-fired plants of at least 800 MW. Source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).

types.name: Wind farms
types.description: Wind capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 300 MW (onshore and offshore; offshore farms snap to the nearest coast hex within 2 hexes). Source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).

types.name: Solar farms
types.description: Utility-scale solar capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 150 MW (rooftop solar not included). Source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).

types.name: Geothermal field
types.description: Geothermal capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 50 MW. Source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).

types.name: Biomass plant
types.description: Biomass and waste plants of at least 150 MW. Source: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).
